name: @mcp-abap-adt/compact

tools.name: HandlerGet
tools.description: Read operation. part selects the aspect: source (default), metadata, urls, or contents (the objects of a PACKAGE); a part the type does not offer is refused, naming the ones it does. object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*), DOMAIN(domain_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*), TABLE(table_name*), STRUCTURE(structure_name*), DDL(ddl_name*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*), CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TEST_CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TYPES(class_name*), LOCAL_DEFINITIONS(class_name*), LOCAL_MACROS(class_name*), PROGRAM(program_name*) [onprem only], INTERFACE(interface_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name*, function_group_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(behavior_definition_name*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(behavior_implementation_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(metadata_extension_name*), UNIT_TEST(run_id*), CDS_UNIT_TEST(run_id*).

object_type.description: ABAP object type for routed compact operation.

part.description: Which aspect to read: the source, the ADT metadata document, the service and preview URLs, or the objects a package contains. A part this object type does not offer is refused, naming the parts it does.

max_results.description: Maximum number of members listed (part contents).

tools.name: HandlerSearch
tools.description: Search ABAP repository objects by name or mask. Required: query*. Optional: object_type, max_results (default 100). Response: one object per line.

query.description: Object name or mask, with * as a wildcard.

object_type.description: ADT object type to restrict the search to.

tools.name: HandlerWhereUsed
tools.description: Where-used list of an ABAP object: the objects that use, call or reference it, with type and package. Required: object_type*, object_name*. Optional: function_group_name (FUNCTION_MODULE), max_results (default 100). Response: JSON.

object_type.description: Type of the object whose usages are listed.

function_group_name.description: Function group of the function module (FUNCTION_MODULE).

max_results.description: Maximum number of referencing objects returned.

tools.name: HandlerGetData
tools.description: Read rows of a table or CDS view: every column of object_name, or what sql_query selects with its columns, conditions and order. Required: object_name or sql_query. Optional: max_rows (default 100). Response: JSON.

object_name.description: Table or CDS view whose rows are read, all columns. Used when sql_query is absent.

sql_query.description: ABAP SQL SELECT naming the columns, conditions and order to read.

tools.name: HandlerValidate
tools.description: Validate before create only. object_type required: CLASS(object_name*), PROGRAM(object_name*) [onprem only], INTERFACE(object_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name*), TABLE(object_name*), STRUCTURE(object_name*), DDL(object_name*), DOMAIN(object_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*), PACKAGE(object_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(object_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(object_name*=service_binding_name*, service_definition_name*).

object_type.description: Object type to validate before create. Supported: CLASS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, PACKAGE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION, SERVICE_BINDING.

object_name.description: Required object name. For SERVICE_BINDING this is the service binding name.

package_name.description: Optional package context for validation (especially for create scenarios).

description.description: Optional object description used during validation.

behavior_definition.description: Optional behavior definition name, used when validating behavior implementation.

root_entity.description: Optional CDS root entity name, used for behavior-related validation.

implementation_type.description: Optional implementation type, used for behavior implementation validation.

service_definition_name.description: Required when object_type=SERVICE_BINDING. Service definition paired with the binding.

service_binding_version.description: Optional service binding version for SERVICE_BINDING.

session_id.description: Optional ADT session id for stateful validation flow.

session_state.description: Optional ADT session state container (cookies/CSRF) for stateful validation flow.

cookies.description: Serialized Cookie header to reuse server session.

csrf_token.description: CSRF token to reuse server session.

cookie_store.description: Cookie key/value map to reuse server session.

tools.name: HandlerCheckRun
tools.description: CheckRun operation (syntax, no activation). object_type required: CLASS(object_name*), PROGRAM(object_name*) [onprem only], INTERFACE(object_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name*), TABLE(object_name*), STRUCTURE(object_name*), DDL(object_name*), DOMAIN(object_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*), PACKAGE(object_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(object_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*).

object_type.description: ABAP object type for routed compact operation.

object_name.description: Primary object name for lifecycle operation.

session_id.description: Optional ADT session id for stateful check flow.

session_state.description: Optional ADT session state container (cookies/CSRF) for stateful check flow.

cookies.description: Serialized Cookie header to reuse server session.

csrf_token.description: CSRF token to reuse server session.

cookie_store.description: Cookie key/value map to reuse server session.

tools.name: HandlerUnitTestStatus
tools.description: ABAP Unit test run status. object_type: not used. Required: run_id*. Optional: with_long_polling. Response: JSON.

with_long_polling.description: Use long polling while waiting for completion.

tools.name: HandlerUnitTestResult
tools.description: ABAP Unit test run result. object_type: not used. Required: run_id*. Optional: with_navigation_uris, format(abapunit|junit). Response: JSON.

with_navigation_uris.description: Include ADT navigation URIs in the result payload.

tools.name: HandlerCdsUnitTestStatus
tools.description: CDS unit test run status. object_type: not used. Required: run_id*. Optional: with_long_polling. Response: JSON.

with_long_polling.description: Use long polling while waiting for completion.

tools.name: HandlerCdsUnitTestResult
tools.description: CDS unit test run result. object_type: not used. Required: run_id*. Optional: with_navigation_uris, format(abapunit|junit). Response: JSON.

tools.name: HandlerProfileList
tools.description: Runtime profiling list. object_type: not used. Required: none. Response: JSON.

tools.name: HandlerProfileView
tools.description: Runtime profiling view. object_type: not used. Required: trace_id_or_uri*, view*(hitlist|statements|db_accesses). Optional: mode(raw|analyze, default raw), top(analyze only), with_system_events, id, with_details, auto_drill_down_threshold. Response: JSON.

mode.description: "raw" returns the parsed trace payload as-is (default). "analyze" returns a compact summary instead — totals plus the top-ranked entries — via the same trace view.

top.description: Number of top-ranked rows to include when mode is "analyze". Default 10. Ignored for mode "raw".

tools.name: HandlerDumpList
tools.description: Runtime feed list, newest first. object_type: not used. Optional: feed_type(dumps|system_messages|gateway_errors, default dumps), user, runtime_error, exception, object_name, package, component, top, from, to. Response: JSON; each dump carries dump_id, and next_to when more remain.

feed_type.description: Which runtime feed to list. Default "dumps" (ABAP short dumps). "system_messages" and "gateway_errors" read the other two ADT runtime feeds through the same call.

runtime_error.description: Dumps whose runtime error contains this text, in any case.

exception.description: Dumps whose exception class contains this text, in any case.

object_name.description: Dumps whose terminated object name contains this text, in any case.

package.description: Dumps whose object package contains this text, in any case.

component.description: Dumps whose application component contains this text, in any case.

top.description: Most entries, up to 1000 (default 50); SAP answers 100 per request and the pages are read in turn.

to.description: End of time range (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS); a previous next_to reads on.

tools.name: HandlerDumpView
tools.description: Runtime dump view. object_type: not used. Required: dump_id* (id or URI). Optional: view(default|summary|formatted). Response: JSON.

dump_id.description: The dump's dump_id, or its URI.

view.description: "summary" — runtime error, exception, terminated program, time, user and termination position; "default" — that summary and the parsed dump; "formatted" — the dump as formatted text.

tools.name: HandlerServiceBindingListTypes
tools.description: Service binding types list. object_type: not used. Required: none. Optional: response_format(xml|json|plain). Response: XML/JSON/plain by response_format.

response_format.description: Response format for protocol types list.

tools.name: HandlerServiceBindingValidate
tools.description: Service binding validate before create. object_type: not used. Required: service_binding_name*, service_definition_name*. Optional: service_binding_version, package_name, description. Response: JSON.

service_definition_name.description: Service definition name to pair with binding.

ddl_name.description: DDL source name (CDS view, AMDP table function, etc.).

tools.name: HandlerActivate
tools.description: Activate operation. Single mode(object_name*, object_type or object_adt_type*). object_type is enough for CLASS, PROGRAM [onprem only], INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, METADATA_EXTENSION, PACKAGE, SERVICE_DEFINITION and SERVICE_BINDING; any other type needs object_adt_type (e.g. "CLAS/OC"). FUNCTION_MODULE needs the batch mode with objects[].parentName set to its function group, because a module is addressed under the group. Batch mode(objects[].name*, objects[].type*, objects[].parentName, objects[].uri).

object_type.description: ABAP object type for routed compact operation. For single-object activation, this alone is enough — no ADT type code needed.

object_name.description: Object name for single-object activation form.

object_adt_type.description: ADT object type code (e.g. CLAS/OC, PROG/P), for a type object_type does not cover. Only needed when object_type is not enough; prefer object_type otherwise.

objects.description: Explicit objects list for batch activation.

parentName.description: Owning object, for a part of one — a function module needs its function group here, or the address is built under a group named after the module.

tools.name: HandlerProfileRun
tools.description: Runtime profiling run. object_type: not used. Required: target_type*(CLASS|PROGRAM) + class_name* for CLASS or program_name* for PROGRAM [onprem only — ABAP Cloud has no programs]. Optional: profiling(default true; set false for a plain run with no trace), profiling flags, description. Response: JSON.

profiling.description: Whether to capture a profiler trace while running. Default true. Set false for a plain run with no tracing — the profiling flags below are then ignored.
